title: 幾年次以後出生的成人需要評估接種 MMR 疫苗？
question: 幾年次以後出生的成人需要評估接種 MMR 疫苗？
answerMarkdown: 依據 2025 年 4 月 16 日修訂的「國內現行 MMR 預防接種建議」，1966 年（含）以後出生、不具麻疹免疫力的成人，若計畫前往麻疹流行地區，建議出國前 2 至 4 週至旅遊醫學門診評估自費接種 1 劑 MMR 疫苗；醫護人員及經常接觸外國人者亦建議評估接種。1981 年的舊分界已不再適用。
summary: 1966 年（含）以後出生、不具麻疹免疫力的成人，出國前往流行地區前 2–4 週建議評估自費接種 MMR。

en.question: Which adults should be assessed for MMR vaccination?
en.answerMarkdown: Under the recommendation revised on 16 April 2025, adults born in 1966 or later who lack measles immunity and plan to travel to areas with measles should visit a travel clinic 2 to 4 weeks before departure to be assessed for one self-paid MMR dose. Health workers and people in frequent contact with foreign nationals should also be assessed. The former 1981 cut-off no longer applies.
